title: gh api --paginate --slurp repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones?state=all&per_page=100
description: The repository's milestones, open and closed, as an array of the pages gh read, each an array: every one, which kit draws as the milestones stage's in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:milestones, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::github_milestones). The mark of the milestones, with --include and the first page of this path, is the ETag of the answer (forge/github:marks), whose body kit does not read; GitHub's milestones list takes no sort by update, so an edit past the first 100 goes unseen. The types are those of GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones in GitHub's REST OpenAPI, https://github.com/github/rest-api-description, as https://docs.github.com/rest/issues/milestones describes them.

due_on.description: The due date, as a time at midnight UTC, null for none.
